executive_summary: Current ad performance shows a healthy engagement rate with an average CTR of 3.87%, indicating strong creative resonance. However, the cost efficiency has declined compared to historical benchmarks. While the 'JULY ADS 2026' campaign is driving the most volume, its cost per message is highly volatile, ranging from 45.71 to 317.71. The 'Leads' objective currently outperforms the 'Sales' objective in terms of inquiry generation cost.

best_campaigns.name: 📁 2026 | Leads | Multi Models | JULY
best_campaigns.reason: Achieved the lowest cost per message in the current period (41.29 on peak days) and maintains a stable CTR above 4.5%.

best_campaigns.name: JULY ADS 2026
best_campaigns.reason: Highest total volume of messages (15) and peak CTR of 5.23%, showing strong top-of-funnel interest.

worst_campaigns.name: 📁 2026 | Sales | Multi Models | July
worst_campaigns.reason: High cost per message (average >100) and lower CTR compared to Lead-gen focused campaigns.

worst_campaigns.name: JULY ADS 2026 (July 6 Performance)
worst_campaigns.reason: Incurred 317.71 spend for only 1 message, indicating a breakdown in conversion efficiency on that specific day.

winning_ads.insight: The low monthly payment hook (₱15K+) is driving significantly higher engagement than broad model promos.
Highest efficiency in the Sales objective category during the early July period.

creative_insights.performance: Top performer. Monthly payment messaging (₱15K+) is the strongest hook for the Metro South audience.
Historically the strongest driver of low-cost inquiries (16-17 pesos), but currently underperforming in the 'Sales' objective format.
Historical data shows 'Client Release Videos' and 'TRY VIDEO ADS' campaigns achieved higher engagement volumes, yet current active ads are predominantly static images.

historical_insights.detail: Historical Cost Per Message (CPMtg) for L300/Mirage was as low as 16.84 - 18.52 in early 2026. Current July costs are 3x to 5x higher (45.00 - 90.00+).
Current CPMs (363.62) are significantly higher than the historical 2023-2024 averages which often sat below 150.00, suggesting increased competition or audience fatigue in Metro South.

recommendations.suggestion: Reallocate 40% of budget from 'OUTCOME_SALES' campaigns to 'OUTCOME_LEADS' as lead forms/messenger leads are currently 50% cheaper.
Pause the 'JULY ADS 2026' campaign during days where Cost Per Message exceeds 120.00. Use automated rules to cap daily spend if no messages are received by 12 PM.
Develop new video content featuring 'Client Deliveries' (Release Videos). Historical data proves this format drove massive engagement for the L300 and Xpander models.
The 18-65 Messenger set is outperforming the 25-55 set. Broaden the age targeting in Sales campaigns to match the successful Leads campaign structure.
